data.body: Cross-epic landing rule (2026-09-07): the test-suite epic's single-owner story aware-obvious-sphinx (7300-7fab-807c-4ea0) extends `_WIRED_GATES` in `tests/unit/test_make_lint_hygiene_wiring.py` to every `make lint` script, including `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py`. This story deletes that script and its `Makefile:298-310` line. If that story has landed first, this story also removes the `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py` entry from `_WIRED_GATES` (add `tests/unit/test_make_lint_hygiene_wiring.py` to this change); if this story lands first, that story simply never adds the entry. Also: the reconciler move story gunshy-symmetric-barnacle edits `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py:130-131` and the test-suite story also deletes four tests from `tests/unit/test_mcp_library_parity.py`; whichever of those lands after this story finds the files gone and skips those rows.
